title: ph publish pushes a package to the Vetra registry so Connect can offer to install it on demand
content:
## The registry publish path

`ph publish` is a thin wrapper around `npm publish` that resolves and injects the registry URL for you. Resolution order is `--registry` flag > `PH_REGISTRY_URL` env > `powerhouse.config.json` > built-in default. Everything after the recognised flags is forwarded verbatim to `npm publish`.

### First publish

Two files must agree before the first push: `powerhouse.manifest.json` (set `name`, `description`, `publisher`) and `package.json` (`name` must match). Then authenticate. The academy still teaches the htpasswd path:

```bash
npm adduser --registry=https://registry.vetra.io
ph publish --registry=https://registry.vetra.io
```

The CLI source has moved ahead of that: `publish` first tries to mint a **Renown** bearer token bound to the registry (5-minute TTL) from the identity created by `ph login`, and only falls back to `npm whoami` / `npm adduser` if that fails. If both fail it prints `Run: ph login (recommended) or npm adduser --registry <url>` and exits 1. `ph registry-login` does the token-to-`~/.npmrc` step on its own.

### The prerelease guard

If `package.json`'s version carries a prerelease id (`1.1.0-beta.0`) and no `--tag` was passed, npm refuses to publish without an explicit dist-tag. `ph publish` detects this: in a TTY it prompts *"Publish with --tag beta?"*; in CI (or any non-TTY) it exits 1 with instructions rather than guessing. Numeric-only prerelease ids (`1.0.0-0`) are skipped because npm requires an alphanumeric dist-tag.

### Why it matters

Registry publishing is what unlocks **dynamic package loading**: drop an exported document into a local drive in Connect, and Connect reads the required package from the file, then offers to install it from the registry — no pre-provisioned environment. Bump `version` before every subsequent publish. This flow landed in `ph-cmd` 6.0.0-dev.153; projects scaffolded earlier need migrating.

_Source: `apps/academy/docs/academy/03-Build/05-Launch/02-PublishYourProject.md` and `clis/ph-cli/src/commands/publish.ts`, Powerhouse v6.2.2-dev.45._
description: `ph publish --registry=https://registry.vetra.io` wraps npm publish. Connect then detects a dropped document's required package and prompts to install it from the registry.
